crossRefs.note: “Now therefore let Pharaoh look for a discreet and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt.
Pharaoh said to his servants, “Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom is the Spirit of God?”
The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish. The counsel of the wisest counselors of Pharaoh has become stupid. How do you…

translations.web: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.
translations.bsb: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.
translations.kjv: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.
translations.asv: To bind his princes at his pleasure, And teach his elders wisdom.
